build.//: Just build. Nixpacks already ran `npm ci` in its install phase, and re-running it here fails with EBUSY: npm clears node_modules before installing, but the builder has a cache mounted at node_modules/.cache that cannot be removed. Every build dependency lives in `dependencies`, so nothing is missing.

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy && npx next start -p ${PORT:-3000}
